8c8a3e036ea98935db1b829ee2f0e35bf2256de2.sourceText:
1.  工程构成：stm32工程是由C语言和汇编语言的库组成的工程，所以有主函数，符合C/C++语言的结构。

2.  程序运行顺序：除了预编译等，程序从主函数开始运行，而且非常符合C/C++运行顺序，从主函数开始会逐行运行代码，然后会进入死循环。

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image94.webp)

3.  主函数内必须的组成部分：死循环\[while(true)或者for(;;)\]，因为单片机要一直运行下去，所以有个死循环。

4.  HAL库 与 用户自定义库

    1.  库：

        1.  .h文件声明函数

        2.  .c/.cpp文件定义函数

        3.  .c/.cpp文件调用函数

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image95.webp)
8c8a3e036ea98935db1b829ee2f0e35bf2256de2.translatedText:
1.  Project composition: an STM32 project is a project composed of C language and assembly language libraries, so it has a main function and conforms to the structure of the C/C\+\+ language\.

2.  Program execution order: apart from preprocessing and similar steps, the program starts running from the main function, and it conforms very closely to the C/C\+\+ execution order: starting from the main function, the code runs line by line, and then enters an infinite loop\.

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image94.webp)

3.  Required components within the main function: an infinite loop\[while(true)或者for(;;)\]because the microcontroller must keep running, so there is an infinite loop\.

4.  HAL library and user\-defined libraries

    1.  Libraries:

        1.  \.h files declare functions

        2.  \.c/\.cpp files define functions

        3.  \.c/\.cpp files call functions

    ![](https://cdn.tungchiahui.cn/tungwebsite/assets/images/2023/10/09/image95.webp)

8c8ca53c26cd2b3b8197cb074f1ad04bb524deff.sourceText:
1. 突然烂图
   1. 如果你的环境很简单，那么跑图的时候可能会突然烂图，这个时候，大概率是do_loop_closing的问题，你把do_loop_closing设置成false再试试。
   这个东西是SLAM用激光检测形状来匹配之前走过的路，如果他匹配到的形状差不多他会把当前这段轨迹和以前的轨迹连起来，然后重新优化整张 pose graph，让地图整体更一致。
   主要是为了防止odom会漂，因为 odom 会漂，机器人最后回到起点时，SLAM 可能觉得位置差了几十厘米，但是可以通过激光雷达矫正。
   2. 在窄通道尽量直线过去，不要原地旋转等等，这种窄通道炸了大概率是scan matching相关参数的问题。
8c8ca53c26cd2b3b8197cb074f1ad04bb524deff.translatedText:
1. sudden map corruption
   1. If your environment is simple, the map may suddenly become corrupted while running\. In this case, it is most likely a do_loop_closing issue\. Try setting do_loop_closing to false and test again\.    This thing is used by SLAM to detect shapes with laser and match against previously traversed paths\. If it matches a similar shape, it will connect the current trajectory segment with previous trajectories, and then re\-optimize the entire pose graph to make the overall map more consistent\.    This is mainly to prevent odom drift, because odom will drift, and when the robot finally returns to the starting point, SLAM may think the position is off by tens of centimeters, but it can be corrected by lidar\.
   2. In narrow passages, try to go straight through as much as possible, do not rotate in place, etc\. If it breaks in such narrow passages, it is most likely a scan matching related parameter issue\.

| `_2` | The second parameter passed when calling a new function | Can be used to adjust the order |
| Fixed value | Written directly in `bind` parameter | By default, it is copied and saved |
| `&Class::method` | Member function pointer | An object still needs to be bound afterward |
| `this` | The current object pointer inside a member function | Often used as the second parameter when binding a member function |
| `std::ref(x)` | Bind by reference `x` | If not written, `std::ref` is usually copied |
